offence_note: Use of imitation firearm during robbery; breach of recognizance
sentence_quote: I will credit you now with nine months of pre-sentence custody and deduct that from the 15 month sentence I would have imposed. The net effect is that I am sentencing you to six months imprisonment on the use of an imitation firearm.
note: 15 months plus 30 days consecutive for breach; victim surcharge waived.

offence_note: Heroin possession for trafficking, importing, conspiracy to import
sentence_quote: We grant leave to appeal the sentence, set aside the sentences imposed, and substitute sentences of 9 years’ imprisonment, to be served concurrently on each of the three convictions.
note: Reduced from 11 years because of post-sentence stroke shown by fresh evidence.

offence_note: Break and enter with intent to commit indictable offence
sentence_quote: Leave to appeal is granted and the sentence is reduced from one of four years imprisonment to three years imprisonment.
note: Reduced for post-sentence rehabilitation; Gladue ground raised but reduction rested on rehabilitation.

offence_note: Criminal harassment, assault with weapon, assault causing bodily harm, kidnapping
sentence_quote: I would set aside the indeterminate sentence and substitute a net determinate sentence under s. 753(4)(b) of four years, to be followed by a long-term supervision order for a period of 10 years.
note: Dangerous offender designation upheld; indeterminate sentence replaced by 10.5 years less 6.5 credit plus LTSO.

offence_note: Sexual assault, obstruct justice, assault with weapon, assault
sentence_quote: Leave to appeal sentence is granted, the appeal is allowed and the sentence on count #8 is varied to one month imprisonment consecutive.
note: Total 4y4m was original; count 8 varied for 34 days credit, new total not stated.

offence_note: First degree murder (Gager) and second degree murder (Smelie)
sentence_quote: Mr. Gager received a sentence of life imprisonment without parole eligibility for 25 years.
note: Smelie sentence appeal dismissed; youth argument rejected.

sentence_quote: I will clarify that and sentence the accused to imprisonment for a period of one day.
note: 15 months deemed served, one day to impose; request to reduce existing 10-year LTSO declined.

offence_note: Criminal contempt breaching Trans Mountain injunction
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal sentence, but dismiss the appeal.
note: Sentence of 28 days already served; judge emphasized denunciation and deterrence despite Gladue.

offence_note: Break and enter and mischief at hog farm protest
co_offenders: Schafer: 120-day conditional sentence and 12 months probation
sentence_quote: the appropriate sentence for each appellant is a 120-day conditional sentence, plus one year of probation.
note: Varied from 30-day intermittent jail plus probation because conditional sentence became available.
